title: TikTok Shop Affiliate Is a Gold Rush (You Don’t Need Followers)
summary: Gary Vaynerchuk livestream calling TikTok Shop affiliate a gold rush for everyday people, then riffing on originality, accountability and forgiveness.

assertions.quote: Tik Tok shop affiliate is a gold rush right now similar to social media in 2012
You make a good piece of content. You post it for some ungodly unknown reason. It gets 9 million views and you just print.

verdicts.note: TikTok distributes by interest rather than follower count, so small accounts occasionally go viral, though it is rare.

assertions.quote: People can make AI content to be affiliate. Like, this is an amazing opportunity
You can post whatever you want. Niche wide. Like, I don't understand how people don't understand that everything works.

verdicts.note: A framing about creative strategy with no clear evidence either way.

assertions.quote: everybody who is struggling on earth is in the business of saying no when approached or presented something of optimism and work
